candidates.name: Web Services Security
verified_facts: The OGC standard applies to OGC Web Services deployed on HTTPS and specifies how services advertise information-assurance controls and security features.
Security controls are advertised through capabilities metadata for interoperable secured services.
semantic_limits: Transport/security conformance protects access and interoperability but does not establish terrain-source accuracy, geometry quality or vertical uncertainty.

candidates.name: Augmented Reality Markup Language 2.0
verified_facts: ARML 2.0 describes virtual objects in augmented-reality scenes, including appearances and anchors related to the real world.
The standard supports dynamic modification of AR scenes through bindings.
semantic_limits: An AR anchor or displayed virtual object is presentation/context data and is not a surveyed parcel elevation or vertical-accuracy certificate.
